name: jamaat-directory
description: A public web directory of community contacts and facilities in jamaats across India.

scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler pages dev ./dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy ./dist
scripts.db:seed:local: npm run gen:seed-sql && wrangler d1 execute jamaat_directory --local --file=./seed.sql
scripts.db:seed: tsx scripts/confirm-wipe.ts && npm run gen:seed-sql && wrangler d1 execute jamaat_directory --remote --file=./seed.sql
scripts.db:import-pilot: tsx scripts/import-listings.ts data/pilot/phase-2-jamaats.csv data/pilot/phase-3-masjids-stays.csv data/pilot/phase-4-food-hotels.csv data/pilot/phase-4b-food-hotels.csv && wrangler d1 execute jamaat_directory --remote --file=./import.sql
scripts.db:purge-samples: npm run gen:purge-samples && wrangler d1 execute jamaat_directory --remote --file=./purge-samples.sql
scripts.db:clear: tsx scripts/confirm-wipe.ts "and leaves it EMPTY." && wrangler d1 execute jamaat_directory --remote --file=./scripts/clear-all.sql
